name: minecraft-mcp
description: Ask about your Minecraft server and let Claude run it: players, worlds, stats, and live events.
long_description: Connects Claude to a Paper server that runs the WorldAPI plugin. Ask who’s online, why the server lags, who played the most this week, or have it set the time, give items, and kick a griefer. The WorldAPI token you enter decides what Claude may do: a read token only looks.

worldapi_url.title: WorldAPI URL
worldapi_url.description: Your server’s WorldAPI address including /api/v1, such as http://localhost:8110/api/v1

worldapi_token.title: WorldAPI token
worldapi_token.description: A token from WorldAPI’s in-game menu or config.yml. Empty gives what anonymous visitors may read.

player.title: Your player name
player.description: Optional: who “I” and “me” mean when you ask about yourself

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes the server
